desc:
GLUTEN FREE: They're made without colors from artificial sources and have an excellent source of vitamin C; Gluten free, fat free, and 80 calories per serving

MYSTERY SOLVING SNACKS: Fruit flavored treats shaped like the Scooby-Doo characters for maximum fun

FUN KIDS SNACK: These snack pouches are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box

ON THE GO SNACK: These fruit flavored snacks are a quick and easy go-to that your whole family can enjoy

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of chewy Scooby-Doo Fruit Flavored Snacks, Gluten Free, Value Pack, 22 Ct, 17.6 oz
features:
Features

  1. Made with real fruit puree
  2. Gluten-free and fat-free
  3. No artificial colors
  4. Excellent source of Vitamin C
  5. Only 80 calories per pouch
  6. Giant size – 17.6 oz total

Benefits

  1. Provides fruit nutrients and Vitamin C
  2. Suitable for gluten-sensitive individuals
  3. Healthier snacking with no artificial colors
  4. Convenient for lunchboxes and on-the-go
  5. Low-calorie treat
  6. No fat and low sodium
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Modified Corn Starch, Apple Juice Concentrate. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Fruit Pectin, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Sunflower and/or Canola Oil, Color (vegetable juice, spirulina extract, fruit juice, annatto extract, turmeric extract), Natural Flavor, Carnauba Wax. †Adds A Trivial Amount Of Fat.
